body.purpose: Everything varnick draws: setup copy, problem lines, panel prose, the composer.

transcript.purpose: The brainless components' own rhythm, one notch tighter. Left as they set it.

numeric.purpose: Any figure that updates in place. Tabular figures so it does not jitter.

components.name: Inline action
components.description: The dominant control in the product, and it is a word. Rendered only when the machine accepts the event.
components.html: ✗ The sandbox could not be established.
components.css: .ds-problem { color: var(--bad, #f7768e); font: 400 13px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; } .ds-action { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; color: var(--accent, #7dcfff); cursor: pointer; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice button
components.description: Used only where a genuine choice must be made between options. Selected takes the accent border; neither state fills.
components.css: .ds-choices { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-choice { padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2c2e40); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ground, #1a1b26); color: var(--fg-dim, #8b8fa3); font: 400 13px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice--on { border-color: var(--accent, #7dcfff); color: var(--fg, #c0caf5); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secret field
components.description: Takes a credential once. The value is cleared the moment it is sent and never echoed.
components.html: <input class="ds-field" type="password" placeholder="Paste the token from `claude setup-token`" />
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2c2e40); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ground, #1a1b26); color: var(--fg, #c0caf5); font: 400 13px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; caret-color: var(--accent, #7dcfff); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--fg-faint, #565f89); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The only surface that sits forward of the field. Raised by tone and a hairline, never by shadow.
components.html: This is a Surface, and it is yours. Ask the agent for what this should be instead.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2c2e40); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ground-raised, #1f2030); color: var(--fg-dim, #8b8fa3); font: 400 13px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Seeded admission
components.description: The one component whose job is to reduce trust in what is beside it. Gates on the run being seeded and on nothing else.
components.html: <button class="ds-admission">seeded data — nothing here is measured</button>
components.css: .ds-admission { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: 400 13px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: var(--warn, #e0af68); cursor: pointer; } .ds-admission:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7dcfff); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A terminal that grew a housing. The transcript at the centre is a faithful Claude Code session, and everything varnick draws around it is instrumentation. The housing never competes with the instrument it houses.

The surface is monospace throughout, flat throughout, and square throughout. Not minimalism as taste — a panel is legible because nothing on it is styled for attention. Depth is carried by two greys in the way a recessed bezel is darker than the face around it, and there is no motion anywhere, because motion in a transcript reads as something happening.

The palette was not chosen. It was read off the transcript components so the application and the session it holds are one surface rather than two.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace only, one size (13px), two line-heights
No shadows, no motion, no radius — depth is tonal, state is textual
Colour is semantic and rare; most of the screen is three greys
Controls are text, and exist only when the machine accepts the event
Full-width shell; only prose is capped, at 110ch

rules.name: The Inherited Palette Rule
rules.body: Every value was read off the transcript components rather than chosen, so the application and the session are one surface. A new colour must already exist in the transcript or it does not ship.

rules.name: The Three Greys Rule
rules.body: If a screen is using more than ground, ground-raised and rule for structure, the structure is wrong. Colour is for meaning, not for arranging things.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: 13px everywhere, with no scale above or below it. A heading is a heading because of what it says and where it sits, not because it is larger.

rules.name: The Wide Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose caps at 110ch, not the 65ch an essay wants. A transcript is interleaved with tool output, diffs and absolute paths that must not wrap.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Two greys and a hairline are the entire depth vocabulary. If that is not enough separation, the layout is wrong rather than the elevation.

rules.name: The Still Surface Rule
rules.body: Nothing moves that the machines did not move. Streaming text arriving is motion the product is reporting; everything else would be motion the product is performing.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: No border-radius on anything varnick draws. A rounded corner makes an element read as an object placed on the surface; here every element is the surface.

dos: Do take every new colour from the transcript components. If it is not already in the session, it is not in the product.
Do express hierarchy with colour and position at one 13px size.
Do render a control only when the machine accepts the event, and let its presence be the affordance — no disabled states to style.
Do cap prose at 110ch per block, and let tool output, diffs and paths run full width.
Do carry depth with ground-raised plus a 1px rule border, and nothing else.
Do apply [data-numeric] to any figure that updates in place, so it does not jitter.
donts: Don't add box-shadow, a transition, an animation or an easing token.
Don't add border-radius to anything varnick draws.
Don't show a number the product did not measure — no status pills, health dots, sparklines or usage figures without a live reading behind them.
Don't add a light mode, a theme switcher or a configurable palette.
Don't introduce a second font family or a type scale.
Don't style varnick's chrome louder than the transcript it surrounds.
